events.title: South Korean Club Anyang Cheetahs move to Seoul and change their name to FC Seoul .
토트넘 홋스퍼 paid £7 million for 웨스트햄 유나이티드 striker 저메인 디포 .
Simon Blitz and two partners purchased 올덤 애슬레틱 A.F.C. , rescuing the Football League One club from possible liquidation .
Tunisia beat Morocco 2–1 to clinch the first African Cup of Nations in the country's history.

미들즈브러 won their first ever trophy as a professional club by beating 볼턴 원더러스 in the League Cup final . In the Premier League, 아스널 were still unbeaten and were top of the league with a nine-point advantage over 첼시 and 맨체스터 유나이티드. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and Charlton completed the top five, followed closely by 리버풀 and 애스턴 빌라. Leeds and 레스터 시티 remained in the bottom three, but 울버햄프턴 원더러스 had climbed out of the drop zone at the expense of 포츠머스. 노리치 시티 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 remained at the top of Division One, and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 edged 셰필드 유나이티드 out of an otherwise unchanged play-off zone.
미들즈브러 beat 볼턴 원더러스 2–1 to win the League Cup , the club's first cup in their 128-year history.
